author: Noesis II
title: Appendix: KKT Top‑K (Prometheus Eval 550) vs Noesis — sets-only comparison
abstract: Reads Prometheus II's sets-only KKT pair multipliers (storage/prometheus/SOTA_550_kkt_pairs.json) and Noesis KKT (shadow_prices_tol1e8.csv), filters interior pairs using Noesis boundary set (assuming boundary consensus at tol=1e−8), computes Top‑K (K=25,15) and Jaccards; saves summary to storage/noesis/exports/appendix_prometheus_kkt_compare.json. Returns the Noesis snapshot packing.
